name: D1_alarm_continuous
desc: alarm shock at the sit; silence; ONE unbroken lament from the first head extreme: each swing is a 4-semitone slide down, eased into the next; dies in the hold

name: D2_alarm_droop_glide_continuous
desc: alarm shock; the lament starts as the head starts to droop (a 1.5 s slide 300 -> 260 Hz) and flows without a break into one slide per swing

name: D3_inquire_sobs
desc: 'huh?' shock (inquire) at the sit; then one separate soft glide per swing (0.18 s swell, no click), each lower and quieter

name: D4_alarm_coo_slides
desc: alarm shock; lament from the robot's own coo on a falling tape, one coo per swing (C_coo_slide material)

name: D5_alarm_inquire_sighs
desc: alarm shock; lament from reversed inquire quacks (falling sighs), one per swing (C_inquire_sigh material)

name: D6_chirp_wave
desc: short chirp shock; one tone whose pitch IS the head yaw (+-3 semitones, extremes on the beats) on a line falling 6 semitones; the most literal sync

name: D7_greet_continuous_low
desc: plain quack as the shock; unbroken lament starting lower (220 Hz) with 5-semitone slides: heavier

name: D8_noshock_continuous
desc: no shock at all (the sit is silent); the unbroken lament alone, for comparison

name: S1_droop_glide_continuous
desc: a soft 2 s slide (300 -> 250 Hz) while the head goes down, flowing into one unbroken slide per swing, dying in the hold

name: S2_sobs
desc: silence during the droop; one separate soft glide per swing, each lower and quieter

name: S3_coo_slides
desc: silence during the droop; the robot's own coo on a falling tape, one per swing

name: S4_inquire_sighs
desc: silence during the droop; reversed inquire sighs, one per swing

name: S5_wave
desc: one tone whose pitch is the head yaw on a falling line, from just before the first extreme

name: S6_sigh_then_continuous
desc: a breathy sad2-style glide (330 -> 165 Hz, 1.2 s) as the head droops, a short breath, then the unbroken per-swing lament
